function.name: find_patient_by_phone
function.description: Look up an existing patient by phone number. Call this silently as soon as the caller gives their phone number, before collecting the rest of their details, so you can offer to update an existing record instead of creating a duplicate.

phone_number.description: Optional. Omit this to look up the number the caller is dialing from, which is the normal case. Only pass a value if the caller explicitly gives a different number.

function.name: register_patient
function.description: Save a new patient registration. Only call this AFTER reading all collected information back to the caller and getting their confirmation. If the result contains field errors, re-ask the caller for only those specific fields and call again.

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth in MM/DD/YYYY format. Must be in the past.

phone_number.description: Omit unless the caller explicitly asked for a different number on file — their calling number is used automatically. Never guess or invent this value.

state.description: Two-letter U.S. state abbreviation, e.g. CA.

email.description: Optional. Only include if the caller provided it.

function.name: update_patient
function.description: Update an existing patient record. Use this when find_patient_by_phone found a record and the caller confirmed they want to update rather than register again. Only include the fields the caller wants to change.
